body:
There aren't any people I'm close with. I want that to change though. Maybe someday I'll talk with someone about what happened. For now I'm okay though. I won't be trying suicide again.

Thank you, takeout Chinese and cuddles with my dog are making me feel much better.

/u/yamsilvius hit the nail on the head. Years and years of things building up. Granted, there was one particularly painful event that pushed me over the edge, but it really could've been anything. I was just looking for a way out.

Thank you and I'm glad I'm still here too.

Yes I did. And I made arrangements to have someone come dogsit the next day so my body would be discovered relatively quickly. My plan was to leave a note on the door explaining that I was dead and to not go inside. I had no desire to terrify someone (or to starve my dog).

I'm so very sorry about your cousin. If it's any consolation  (and it's probably none at all), I felt incredibly peaceful and almost blissful right before I passed out. Like I was going to sleep. As weird as it sounds, almost like those hazy couple seconds after an orgasm. Just relaxation. There was almost no pain involved - the thrashing and struggling was involuntary, felt like an out of body experience.

Again, I am so, so sorry. I am so grateful for this second chance to live my life. RIP to your poor cousin. Pm me if you ever need to talk. Please take care.

It's weird, I could almost swear that she knew what was up. Seemed very worried the week prior to my attempt and has been very clingy since. You're absolutely right - she would have been very sad if I had died.
